visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a man with dark hair styled in a middle part, wearing a black short-sleeved button-down shirt. He stands at the glass entrance of a building with bright indoor lighting. A vertical wooden sign with dark characters reads '上誠牙醫診所' (Shang Cheng Dental Clinic). The man gestures towards the clinic, his expression friendly and engaging as he looks directly at the camera. (2) The scene shifts to the man sitting at a desk, meticulously filling out a white medical questionnaire with a blue pen. He is then seen standing inside a large white dental X-ray machine; a red laser line scans across his face while he holds a yellow bite piece in his mouth. A dental assistant in purple scrubs and a red cardigan assists him. Later, he sits in a dental chair with his mouth wide open as a female dentist in a blue gown takes a photo of his oral cavity with a smartphone. (3) The man looks surprised and makes a questioning face. A dentist's hand in white latex gloves demonstrates the 'relative position' of jaw molds. The man is then seen in a consultation room with an older male dentist with greyish hair, who is reviewing documents. The man listens intently, nodding as they discuss his health status. The lighting remains bright and professional throughout the clinic. (4) A transition screen appears with the text '一個月後' (One month later) on a blurred background. The man, now wearing a white shirt over a light green t-shirt, holds a translucent plastic dental appliance (a snore stopper). He carefully places it over his upper teeth and bites down, adjusting it with his fingers. He smiles at someone off-camera, appearing comfortable and satisfied with the fit. The video ends with a yellow background and downward-pointing arrows.
